legend: After too much playing on paper, Iahub has switched to computer games. The game he plays is called "Block Towers". It is played in a rectangular grid with n rows and m columns (it contains n × m cells). The goal of the game is to build your own city. Some cells in the grid are big holes, where Iahub can't build any building. The rest of cells are empty. In some empty cell Iahub can build exactly one tower of two following types:
Blue towers. Each has population limit equal to 100.

Red towers. Each has population limit equal to 200. However, it can be built in some cell only if in that moment at least one of the neighbouring cells has a Blue Tower. Two cells are neighbours is they share a side.

Iahub is also allowed to destroy a building from any cell. He can do this operation as much as he wants. After destroying a building, the other buildings are not influenced, and the destroyed cell becomes empty (so Iahub can build a tower in this cell if needed, see the second example for such a case).

Iahub can convince as many population as he wants to come into his city. So he needs to configure his city to allow maximum population possible. Therefore he should find a sequence of operations that builds the city in an optimal way, so that total population limit is as large as possible.
He says he's the best at this game, but he doesn't have the optimal solution. Write a program that calculates the optimal one, to show him that he's not as good as he thinks.
input: The first line of the input contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 500). Each of the next n lines contains m characters, describing the grid. The j-th character in the i-th line is '.' if you're allowed to build at the cell with coordinates (i, j) a tower (empty cell) or '#' if there is a big hole there.
output: Print an integer k in the first line (0 ≤ k ≤ 106) — the number of operations Iahub should perform to obtain optimal result.
Each of the following k lines must contain a single operation in the following format:
«B x y» (1 ≤ x ≤ n, 1 ≤ y ≤ m) — building a blue tower at the cell (x, y);
«R x y» (1 ≤ x ≤ n, 1 ≤ y ≤ m) — building a red tower at the cell (x, y);
«D x y» (1 ≤ x ≤ n, 1 ≤ y ≤ m) — destroying a tower at the cell (x, y).
If there are multiple solutions you can output any of them. Note, that you shouldn't minimize the number of operations.

output.ai: 第一行输出一个整数 k（0 ≤ k ≤ 10^6）——Iahub 为得到最优结果需要执行的操作数。
接下来的 k 行中的每一行都必须包含一个如下格式的操作：
«B x y»（1 ≤ x ≤ n，1 ≤ y ≤ m）——在单元格 (x, y) 建造一座蓝塔；
«R x y»（1 ≤ x ≤ n，1 ≤ y ≤ m）——在单元格 (x, y) 建造一座红塔；
«D x y»（1 ≤ x ≤ n，1 ≤ y ≤ m）——拆除单元格 (x, y) 处的一座塔。
如果有多个解，你可以输出其中任意一个。注意，你不应最小化操作次数。

legend.ai: 在纸上玩了太久之后，Iahub 转而开始玩电脑游戏。他玩的游戏叫作“方块塔”。游戏在一个有 n 行 m 列的矩形网格中进行（包含 n × m 个单元格）。游戏的目标是建造属于自己的城市。网格中的一些单元格是大坑，Iahub 无法在其中建造任何建筑。其余单元格为空。在某个空单元格中，Iahub 可以恰好建造以下两种类型的塔中的一种：
蓝色塔。每座塔的人口上限为 100。
红色塔。每座塔的人口上限为 200。不过，只有在建造时至少有一个相邻格子中存在蓝色塔，才能在某个格子中建造红色塔。两个格子共边时，它们互为相邻格子。
Iahub 还可以摧毁任意格子中的建筑。他可以任意次执行此操作。摧毁建筑后，其他建筑不会受到影响，被摧毁的格子会变为空格（因此，如果需要，Iahub 可以在该格子中建造一座塔，第二个样例展示了这种情况）。
Iahub 可以说服任意多的人口来到他的城市。因此，他需要配置城市，使其容纳尽可能多的人口。为此，他应找到一个以最优方式建造城市的操作序列，使总人口上限尽可能大。
他说自己是这个游戏中最厉害的，但他并没有最优解。请编写一个程序计算出最优解，以向他证明他并没有自己想象中那么厉害。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n，m ≤ 500）。接下来的 n 行每行包含 m 个字符，用于描述网格。第 i 行第 j 个字符为“.”，表示允许在坐标 (i, j) 处建造塔（该格子为空）；若为“#”，则表示那里有一个大洞。
